goal_and_scope: Resolve the tensor restriction/degeneration versus one-shot rank transfer question for the arbitrary-mask selective matrix product, with an explicit example and exact charged interface.
inherited_inputs: Arbitrary-mask target D=N^(1/4), |W|<=N^(15/8), integer inputs, fully charged O(N^(2-eta)) request.
acquired_inputs: Explicit W tensor with border rank at most two but exact rank three.
Conditional strict gap R(M2)=7 while asymptotic rank <=2^(9/4)<7.
Exact rational rank-preserving Strassen gauge with 84/84 leg coefficients nonzero; singleton tensor-power support activates all 7^k leaves.
Field-independent incidence lower bound |W|D for independent rank-wire evaluation; scope excludes shared encoders.
representation_and_assumptions: Fixed-mask tensor T_(W,D)=sum z_ij x_ik y_kj; exact rank and asymptotic rank are separate. Degeneration yields border rank. Dense-gauge witness over Q preserves exact rank. Target bit account assumes O(log N)-bit entries.
exact_missing_lemma: Uniformly acquire and evaluate a mask-specialized shared circuit for Z_W Y^T in subquadratic fully charged total time, including bit heights and decoding.
comparator: N^(2+o(1)) full thin product with N^2 writes; separate dot products cost |W|D; complete-block obstruction is restricted to independent covers.
falsifier_or_next_experiment: Find and prove a uniform arbitrary-W shared encoder/factorization with acquisition, gate, product, coefficient, bit, decoding, and output costs O(N^(2-eta) polylog N).
unresolved_or_UNKNOWN: A new subquadratic selective circuit remains unconstructed.
No general arithmetic-circuit impossibility is proved.
Release107 theorem correctness and novelty remain unreviewed externally.
status_note: Use the result as a scoped negative finding about generic transfers; do not infer a general algorithmic lower bound.
